mapper.sql: e.id, e.software_id, e.plugin_id, e.slug, e.name_zh, e.name_en, e.summary_zh, e.summary_en, e.author_type, e.author_name, e.author_user_id, e.icon_url, e.theme_color, e.readme_url, e.permissions, e.platform, e.license, e.repo_url, e.status, e.reject_reason, e.featured, e.download_count, e.sort_order, e.created_at, e.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM extension e INNER JOIN software s ON s.id = e.software_id AND s.status = 1 WHERE s.slug = #{slug} AND e.status = 1 ORDER BY e.featured DESC, e.download_count DESC, e.sort_order ASC, e.id ASC

SELECT id, extension_id, version, changelog_zh, changelog_en, object_key, file_size, sha256, status, download_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM extension_release WHERE extension_id = #{extensionId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, extension_id, version, changelog_zh, changelog_en, object_key, file_size, sha256, status, download_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM extension_release WHERE extension_id = #{extensionId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO extension_download (extension_id, release_id, ip_hash, user_agent) VALUES (#{extensionId}, #{releaseId}, #{ipHash}, #{userAgent})
